subject: QBR: Account 'Fingerprints' — runbook & forecast consolidation
messages:
From: Irene Choi <irene_choi@redwood.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>
Date: 2027-05-17T08:14:00-07:00
Subject: QBR: Account 'Fingerprints' — runbook & forecast consolidation

Team —

We need a crisp set of account-level "fingerprints" for the QBR deck and the exec readout. I'm trying to keep this tight so the ops/finance folks can run the consolidated forecast. Please do the following for your book: 

- Produce a one-page snapshot per named account (file name: <ACCOUNT>_fingerprint) with: current ARR, committed close date, confidence (G/A/R), top 3 risks, top 3 asks from Redwood, and any technical blockers.
- Use the attached QBR_account_fingerprint_template.csv — populate and return.
- Call out any forecast deltas vs. last commit and include a short note on source (procurement, legal, technical).
- If you own a deal that maps to RDW-2194, add the estimate range and state whether Q3->Q4 slip is likely.

Deadlines: initial drafts by EOD 2027-05-18; final packet by COB 2027-05-21.

I'll consolidate into the exec slides and run a 30-min sync Wed morning if needed.

Attachments: QBR_account_fingerprint_template.csv

Thanks —
Irene
Irene Choi
VP, Growth & Field Operations
Redwood Inference

From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
To: Irene Choi <irene_choi@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>
Date: 2027-05-17T10:12:00-07:00
Subject: Re: QBR: Account 'Fingerprints' — runbook & forecast consolidation

On Mon, May 17, 2027 at 08:14 AM, Irene Choi <irene_choi@redwood.com> wrote:
> Team —
> 
> We need a crisp set of account-level "fingerprints" for the QBR deck and the exec readout....

Got it — attaching my first pass for Horizon Health (Horizon_HC_snapshot.xlsx). Highlights: 

- ARR: $1.8M ARR on existing contracts; expansion pipeline +$600k (net-new product).
- Committed close: 2027-06-24 (procurement signoff pending).
- Confidence: Amber — procurement gate still open, legal review requested 5/12.
- Top risks: (1) procurement timeline, (2) SSO integration delays, (3) budget re-allocation to Q4 projects.
- Top asks: accelerated SSO onboarding support, explicit MSA clause for data residency, a one-time credit for pilot months (negotiable).

I've flagged RDW-2194 in the notes — appears to be the core expansion line; I put an optimistic/likely Q3 close with contingency to Q4. See "Notes" tab for source links (procurement email thread).

Attachments: Horizon_HC_snapshot.xlsx

Marissa
Sr. AM, West Region
Redwood Inference

From: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>
To: Irene Choi <irene_choi@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>
Date: 2027-05-17T12:27:00-07:00
Subject: Re: QBR: Account 'Fingerprints' — runbook & forecast consolidation

Thanks, Irene — adding the infra/ops lens here.

A couple of quick technical/ops inputs to include in the fingerprint template (I've added these to the "operational_notes" column in Marissa's spreadsheet):

- Integration status: SSO (in dev), KV-cache warmup testing scheduled 5/21. If SSO slips, customer timelines move 3–4 weeks.
- Perf profile: expected tail latency impact <5% using recommended quantized variant. No model architecture changes required.
- Security/compliance asks: Horizon requested retained logs for 90 days; that will push a private-deployment conversation (cost + approval).

Forecast note on RDW-2194: procurement language suggests a strong preference for a quarterly invoicing start aligned with Horizon's fiscal calendar — that pushes our revenue recognition to Q4 in the conservative case. I'm attaching my notes.

Attachments: RDW-2194-forecast-notes.pdf

Karthik
Principal Solutions Architect
Redwood Inference

From: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>

Date: 2027-05-18T09:03:00-07:00
Subject: Re: QBR: Account 'Fingerprints' — runbook & forecast consolidation

Quick operational ask: when you send final snapshots, can we add a one-line "exec takeaway" up top — e.g., "High confidence, needs SSO support"? That makes the consolidation slide much easier for the CRO.

Also — would recommend we loop Susan Reed (Acme contact) and MJ Lopez (Horizon procurement) into one of the final emails to confirm timing/close windows (only after the internal snapshot is locked). I can draft a short confirm note if you'd like.

Ben

Redwood Inference

Thanks for the quick turn. Consolidating notes and next steps below — cc'ing MJ and Susan to give visibility; we will not send any external confirm until internal snapshots are final.

Summary of next steps: 
- Marissa: incorporate Karthik's ops inputs into Horizon_HC_snapshot.xlsx + add a one-line "Exec Takeaway." Updated draft due EOD 2027-05-18.
- Karthik: finalize RDW-2194 operational note and confirm whether the log retention ask requires a Private deployment conversation.
- Ben: please draft the short confirm note to procurement/contacts (Susan/MJ) — we'll send after internal lock.
- Irene: I will consolidate into the exec packet and build a single slide per account. Target deck ready for review by 2027-05-21 11:00 AM PT.

Attachments to follow (final consolidated CSV + slides).

Thanks — appreciate the rapid turnaround.
